title: Just Juice Reborn Berry Burst 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Reborn Berry Burst 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a revitalised take on a classic wild berry medley. The profile opens with the soft, jammy sweetness of ripe Strawberry alongside the earthy, mellow notes of juicy Blueberry. On the exhale, the deep, rich tang of dark Blackberry emerges, followed by a subtle cooling sensation that leaves a smooth and highly satisfying finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. Formulated with a specific 40VG/60PG ratio, this e-liquid provides exceptional flavour clarity and a slightly more pronounced throat hit. It is designed to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Just Juice Reborn collection brings back a selection of original e-liquid flavours, refined and updated to deliver a highly concentrated, bar-style experience. Offering exceptional quality and familiarity, this range provides a dependable option for everyday use. Beyond the dark berry notes of Berry Burst, vapers can explore other revitalised profiles such as the sparkling Lemonade or the refreshing Apple & Pear on Ice.
